Definition: of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig:--untimely fig.
BiblicalUsage: Olynthos is an untimely fig, a fig out of season, cast before it ripens. It occurs once, in Revelation 6:13, where the stars of heaven fall to the earth as a fig tree casts her untimely figs when shaken by a mighty wind.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the untimely fig is the picture of a world shaken loose, and the stars fall because the heavens themselves are moved.
